name: Calaf (Spain)
description: Red field with the yellow dog of the arms passant towards the hoist and a yellow thistle of three flowers in the upper hoist.
history: The flag was approved by the Generalitat on 6 July 2016 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 7164 of 18 July 2016; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the yellow dog passant towards the hoist and the yellow thistle of three flowers of the arms.

features.role: dog passant towards the hoist, 19/32 of the height
